Presets.Label: Sets
Presets.Hint: Allows randomly changing equipment sets and characteristics for an actor when placing them on the scene.

Weight.Label: Weight
Weight.Hint: The higher the value, the higher the chance of obtaining this set.

ChangeCharacteristics.Label: Modify characteristics
ChangeCharacteristics.Hint: Allows changing all actor characteristics to the specified value.

RandomCharacteristics.Label: Random characteristics
RandomCharacteristics.Hint:
If enabled, when moving the token to the scene, random characteristics will be generated according to the Rulebook.

Generates random characteristic values by subtracting 10 points from the specified value and then adding 2d10 points. Thus, a characteristic value of 30 will become random, equal to 20 + 2d10. If the characteristic is 5, it simply rolls 1d10 and uses the result as the new characteristic value.

DeathTint.Label: Token tint on death
DeathTint.Hint: If the actor's wounds drop to 0, the token will be colored with the specified color.
DeathTint.Default: Base color the token will be tinted if wounds are greater than 0.

GenerateSpells.Label: Random spells
GenerateSpells.Hint: If enabled, when moving the token to the scene, it will be given the specified number of random spells from the selected Magic School.
GenerateSpells.Arcane: If enabled, common spells will be added to the search pool.

Disposition.Label: Token disposition
Disposition.Hint: Changes the disposition of the token when moved to the scene.

WFRP4E.greatMaw.descriptions: Whenever an Ogre Butcher successfully casts a spell from the Lore of The Great Maw, the offering they consume may restore their own health. Roll [[/r 1d10]]. If the result is a 10, or if it is equal to or higher than the CN of the spell being cast, unmodified by Channeling or the use of a Grimoire, the Butcher recovers Wounds equal to the unmodified CN of the spell.
WFRP4E.little-waaagh.descriptions: The spells of Goblin (and some Hobgoblin) Shamans tend to manifest the Waaagh! as spiteful tricks and hexes. Goblin Shamans grow in confidence as their spells work. If they generate any SL on their Casting Tests, they may spend it on Overcasting or may use it to buy a single Fortune Point. Fortune Points earned in this way can take the Shaman’s normal Fortune above it’s maximum, but must be spent by the end of the encounter, or are lost.
WFRP4E.big-waaagh.descriptions: Orc and some Hobgoblin Shamans know an array of crude Orc magic. A selection of their repertoire is provided here. Spells of the Big Waaagh! act as conduits for massive ammounts of Waaagh! energy, and its release emboldens the hearts of nearby Orcs, Goblins, and Hobgoblins. Whenever a Character casts a spell of the Big Waaagh! any Orcs, Hobgoblins, or Goblins within Willpower yards lose any @Condition[Broken] Conditions.
